label.zh: 细缝被撕开成“微型宇宙”裂隙
label.en: The scar opens as the Microverse rift

bridges.evidence: events/astral_planes_events.txt:4127-4135 (6008 option: from = { split_astral_scar = { ID = microverse } }); common/scripted_effects/astral_planes_effects.txt:49-85 split_astral_scar -> spawn_astral_rift id = $ID$; rift definition common/astral_rifts/00_astral_rifts.txt:139

note.zh: 特殊项目 60 天、限时 1080 天：按时完成进入 6006，超时失败则细缝自行坍缩（6009）。
note.en: The special project takes 60 days with a 1080-day limit: completing it opens 6006; if it expires the scar collapses on its own (6009).

note.zh: 细缝被封闭并从星系中移除；获得大量星界丝缕与物理研究。
note.en: The scar is sealed and removed from the system; a large astral thread reward and physics research.

note.zh: 项目超时：细缝向内坍缩并消失，抛出少量星界丝缕。
note.en: The project expired: the scar collapses inward and disappears, releasing a small amount of astral threads.

notes.zh: 触发：科研船勘察一处星界细缝时（on_survey_planet → 隐藏事件 astral_planes.6005），帝国需已掌握星界采集与裂隙探球科技、境内有星界细缝、尚未探索过“微型宇宙”、且此前未发现过这种不稳定；满足时 80% 概率开启本项目，20% 什么也不发生。
notes.en: Trigger: when a science ship surveys an Astral Scar (on_survey_planet → hidden event astral_planes.6005), if the empire has Astral Harvesting and Rift Sphere, owns a scar within its borders, has not explored the Microverse and has not found an instability before: 80% chance to open this project, 20% nothing.

scope.zh: 已核对触发（on_survey_planet、6005 的条件与 80/20 随机）、特殊项目（60 天、1080 天时限、需科学家）、6006 两个选项与 6007/6008/6009；补上 6008 通往“微型宇宙”裂隙的跨故事链接。
scope.en: Checked the trigger (on_survey_planet, 6005 conditions and the 80/20 roll), the special project (60 days, 1080-day limit, scientist required), both options of 6006 and 6007/6008/6009; added the cross-story link from 6008 to the Microverse rift.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that system appears here.
